g.title: dsp_synth
g.text: DECtalk DTC-01 v1.8: the synthesizer in the DSP (TMS32010)

parwav's cascade/parallel layout at 10 kHz: one DAC sample per 100 µs, 64 samples per frame. Every filter is B·y[n−1] + C·y[n−2] + A·x, Q12, summed in the 32-bit accumulator. Labels and addresses: dsp/dsp_v1.8.lst.

g.title: cluster_parallel
g.text: (PARALLEL_BRANCH 0x632): frication and bursts, on the noise

g.title: pf6
g.text: B C fixed at reset · A = A6·gf

g.title: glot
g.text: open phase: a −= b; v += a/16; out = v·gv

g.title: dac
g.text: every 64 samples: poll for the next frame

g.title: osc2
g.text: the same, on its own phase

g.title: words
g.text: a block's fill colour says which of these updates it; white blocks are plain per-sample arithmetic; + and − are the signs in the output sum
f4 b4 f5 b5 (scaled by head size on the 68000) · p4 p5 · la · g1…g5 · ri nf · br · hs · gf gn gv gh
ap·10 and 41·pr are sent but only the 68000 uses them · checksum: sum & 0x7FFF = 0 · clears the cascade's history
T0 = 40000/F0 · F1 F2 F3 · FNZ · B1 B2 B3 · AV · AH · A2 … A6 · AB · TLT · trailer 0x43D4
FRAME_COEFFS 0x456: head size hs (Q12) moves F1 about 256 Hz, F2 about 512 Hz, F3 about 0 → F1′ F2′ F3′;
sets the parallel F2 F3 and all the parallel gains; dB words → amptable[dB + 10], 0 unless dB > −10
latches the latest frame into the cascade F1 F2 F3 and the nasal zero, AV, the tilt, nopen, nmod, br·T0, the skew
resonator: B = cos f · (1 − bw), C = 2·bw − 1, A = gain · (1 − B − C) ≫ 11 (cos_lookup: 229 steps, 4…64 Hz apart)
RESET_COEFFS: the nasal pole's and the parallel F6's B C, the 4× low-pass, the LFSR seed, the FNZ offset 31
